verdict.rationale: Deletion is documented: the API lets you list, get, update and delete ingested documents, and the security guide says to scope each user to a container tag and delete that container's content when they request deletion. Self-hosting also keeps all data on your own hardware. There is no evidence of explicit retention controls such as TTLs, auto-expiry or configurable retention windows. missing for 10: configurable retention policies/automatic expiry, documentation on whether deletion is complete or recoverable (including derived memories and graph facts), independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
